title: Retiring a twenty-year warehouse in a bank: inventory first, switch-off as the goal
summary: A vendor case study on a large bank moving thousands of feeds, close to a thousand use cases and more than 140 reporting suites from Teradata to Databricks SQL while keeping regulatory reporting uninterrupted and re-skilling 1,200-plus users.
